name: alert-dialog
useFor: Use to confirm an action that is destructive or hard to undo (remove a site, rescore every site). Name the action on the confirming key (Remove site), never just OK. Use size="sm" with AlertDialogMedia for a short centered question. Content taller than the screen fades at an edge (fade-y) where more scrolls past it.
constraints: Information that needs no answer (use a toast)
source: Not in Figma. Drawn in Mireye's grammar: the dialog's panel
title: Alert Dialog
description: The dialog's framed cut panel for a confirmation: a 16px regular title, a line in the secondary ink and two keys at the end; no close key, and a click outside does not dismiss it.
